_help: The Earn coins tasks on My Progress (Coins tab). id and coins must match the quests list in supabase/008_quests_referrals.sql (a test checks). type: auto (checked by the database), post (the player pastes the link to their X post), honor (trusted, small, once). link: social for the honor tasks, read from social in config.js; a task whose link is empty is hidden. need: what the button waits for in this browser before it can be claimed.
title: Earn coins
line: Quick tasks. Each one pays once.

quests.title: Post about web3.toys on X
quests.line: Share your invite link or a result in your own words, then paste the link to your post.

invite.title: Invite friends
invite.line: You get 200 coins and your friend gets 50 when they earn a certificate and finish 3 toys.
invite.post: I'm learning web3 with little 5 minute toys on web3.toys. Free, fun, and you earn certificates. Try it:

spendLine: Reports, HD certificates and books can be unlocked with coins instead of money.
noCash: Coins are site points. They unlock extras and paid items on web3.toys, but have no cash value and can never be withdrawn, sold or swapped for money, crypto or tokens.
